blind.description: A stylized fantasy wooden lectern featuring an octagonal tiered base with red decorative banding, an octagonal supporting pillar, and an angled bookstand surface. Resting upon the tilted rest is a thick dark leather-bound spellbook adorned with brass corner brackets, studs, and a central circular boss, chained along its spine. A small wooden peg or candle holder with a pale candle sits mounted on the right edge of the stand. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized with clean geometry, sitting flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: Shows the top of the angled lectern holding a rectangular dark book with brass corner brackets and a central bronze medallion, with heavy chain links along the right side and a cylindrical candle holder jutting out at the bottom-right corner.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 to 4 feet tall (reaching just below the waist/elbow level of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2 feet wide.
